e: A gun attack in Taphou Kuki village, Kangpokpi district, kills a woman and injures two men.
A bus collides with a truck near Kaziranga National Park in Assam, killing 24 people and injuring 11 others.
Five carriages and the engine of a passenger train operating from Kolkata to Sairang derail near Digaru railway station in Assam.
Four family members drown in a Bikaner water tank after two older brothers and a cousin, including a 16-year-old boy, tried to save a 14-year-old girl who had slipped and fallen in.
A speeding truck rams into a crowd in Khunti district, Jharkhand, killing four women and three children.
A building collapses in Central Delhi district, Delhi, killing six people.
The US imposes new sanctions on companies and individuals in India with ties to the Iranian regime.
A trailer collides with a van in Kushinagar, Uttar Pradesh, killing six people and seriously injuring two others.
Eight people die after being electrocuted when a vehicle comes into contact with a high-voltage power line in Jhunjhunu district, Rajasthan.
Four workers die of suffocation after entering a food waste tank at a hotel in Ujjain, Madhya Pradesh.
Two girls are injured in a chainsaw attack at a school in Raptadu, Andhra Pradesh.
A helicopter crashes in Chamoli district, Uttarakhand, leaving six people missing.
A massive fire at a shoe factory in Delhi kills four people and leaves two others injured.
Seventeen inmates escape from a prison in Theni district, Tamil Nadu. All are recaptured after two days.
Six people are shot, five of them fatally, at a hotel in Guwahati, Assam.
The International Weightlifting Federation awards the hosting rights for the 2029 World Weightlifting Championships to Ahmedabad.
Seven people are killed while two others are seriously injured in a house explosion in Siwan district, Bihar.
A bus crashes into a tree in Manendragarh-Chirmiri-Bharatpur district, Chhattisgarh, killing six people and injuring 40 others.
A private bus falls into a nearly 100-foot-deep gorge in Kashmir, killing two people and injuring around 15 others.
The New Zealand–India Free Trade Agreement comes into effect.
Manipur conflict (2023–present): Three people are killed and four others are injured during clashes in Manipur.
Fifteen people are killed and 29 others are injured after a truck plows into a crowd of pilgrims in Gwalior district, Madhya Pradesh.
A minibus falls into a 15-foot-deep drain on the Delhi–Mumbai Expressway in Kota district, Rajasthan, killing eight people and injuring 15 others.
A crowd crush at a puja pandal in Kolkata kills 19 people.

A coalition of left-wing civil rights groups, including the National Federation of Indian Women (NFIW) and the All India Democratic Women's Association (AIDWA), marches to the Delhi Police Headquarters, and delivered a formal memorandum calling for the immediate suspension and prosecution of officers implicated in the alleged physical and sexual assaults during the 2026 anti-CEC protests.
A boat capsizes in Vaishali district, Bihar, killing 13 people.
The central government places Delhi under lockdown ahead of the 2026 anti-CEC protests.
The NIA launches a case to investigate the attempted hijacking of Flydubai Flight 1073.
Five people are killed in an explosion at a facility in Sri City, Tirupati district, Andhra Pradesh.
Hashim Moosa, a top Lashkar-e-Taiba commander and the mastermind of the 2025 Pahalgam attack is killed in an encounter with security forces in Budgam, Jammu and Kashmir.
Eight people are injured and one is killed in a major fire at the Mangalore Refinery and Petrochemicals Limited (MRPL) facility in Karnataka.
Riots break out at Lovely Professional University and surrounding areas in Punjab following rumours of a sexual assault on campus.
Nine people are killed in a bus fire on the Yamuna Expressway in Greater Noida.
A 28-year-old man fatally shoots a teacher at a school before killing himself in Lakhimpur Kheri district, Uttar Pradesh.
A Pakistan Navy vessel collides with an Indian Navy vessel in the Arabian Sea, prompting diplomatic protests between both countries.
Five baby orangutans are rescued from a forest in Balasore district, Odisha.
A five-story building collapses in Delhi, killing seven.
A special NIA court in Bastar convicts all 10 accused in the 2013 Naxal attack in Darbha valley. They are subsequently sentenced to death on 16 September.
Defense Minister Rajnath Singh permits the transfer of DRDO missile technologies to Indian private companies.

A National Company Law Tribunal special bench headed by Nileesh Sharma approves a repayment plan for Subhash Chandra, head of Zee Media Corporation where he will pay Rs. 6.5 crores against creditor claims of Rs. 22,006.57 crores.
